utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be great—I’m still only hearing bits and pieces, so I’d love the date and what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can make a late start work, so if you set the time I’ll be there. Just send me the repair list and I’ll jump in on whatever’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect, thanks, Dane — just send me the time and repair list when you have it, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Opal — I’m gathering tools and a few quick-fix volunteers, so the first thing I need is the pickup windows to help me schedule around them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got Sam down for the hardware store on Maple around 9 a.m. for supplies, and I’ll keep updating the drop-off details as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, that helps a lot — once you have the pickup windows, send them my way and I’ll line up the volunteers around Sam’s supply run.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can swing by with a wrench and a screwdriver for you.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Gus — I really appreciate it. I’m still a bit scattered, but I’ll keep the repair drive in mind.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Noah — just focus on the repair drive when you can. I’ll bring the wrench and screwdriver by soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Vik — just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll help out. I’ll try not to forget this time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll send the list over and keep the repair drive moving. Thanks for jumping in, Oren.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No problem, Vik — I’ll keep an eye out for your list and get right on it. Thanks for keeping the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the supplies covered and I’ll keep setting things aside for the drive. Send me any updates on the list, and I’ll make sure we’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re really up for helping with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely—I’m on it, and I’ll keep the supplies ready for whatever the drive needs.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll send you the repair drive details now, and you can see what fits. We’re starting with a quick list of homes and repairs, then the sign-up info goes out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks—I’ll keep an eye out for the details and take a look when I’m back from errands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—I’ll get those details over to you, and thanks for checking in when you’re back. If you see a repair you can help with, just let me know!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll bring something by later today.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, thanks. I’m mostly worried about the pickup and sorting, so if you can check on the ladder too, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll check the ladder too and bring it by later today.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely — folks are sorting volunteers, tools, and the priority fixes now. If you want, I can fill you in on what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — yes, please fill me in on what’s still needed, and let me know the start time too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — we still need a few more volunteers and a couple of tools for the bigger fixes, and the start time is still being finalized, but I’ll check and let you know as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — I’m organizing the repair drive list now, so if you know of any homes that need help, send them my way and I’ll add them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — I’ll keep an ear out and send along any homes that need help. Thanks for organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — I appreciate it. I’ll keep the list updated and let you know if I need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: They still need a few more hands for sorting and pickup, plus some tape, boxes, and a ladder if anyone can lend one. I can ask around for the bigger items if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I can help sort if that’d be useful, and I can see whether I have any boxes to spare.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that would be a huge help, Uli — sorting is exactly what they need. And if you find those boxes, that’d be great too; I’ll keep checking for a ladder.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time do you want me there?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Around 10 works for me. I’ll have the list ready, and Gus is bringing the tools over shortly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect, I’ll be there at 10 and help get everything set up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m still in — send me the schedule and address, and I’ll take care of my part.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll send you the schedule and address right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — send it over and I’ll take care of my part.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the repair drive details right away, and you can see what fits best.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you really will send the repair drive details?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes — I’ll send the repair drive details right away. Thanks for checking; I’m on it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, we’re still on for the repair drive. I’ll let you know if I hear any updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep the neighbors posted and circle back with the details once we know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — appreciate it. I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out and update you if I hear anything about what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll keep an eye out for you and have a spot ready when you bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Eli — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an ear out too and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thank you, Rey. I’ll stay by the house and keep things ready for Gus’s tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the details first—what needs repairing, and what time is the drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We need help with a few things: some loose chairs, a leaky sink, and a broken gate latch. I can send the schedule and address once I have the pickup windows confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye — that helps. Send the pickup windows when they’re confirmed, and I’ll match the repair list to the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be great—I’m mostly hearing bits and pieces, so I’d love the date and what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — just send me the date and what still needs fixing, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds good — I’m still piecing it together, so I’ll send along the date and the main fixes as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely — folks are sorting volunteers, tools, and the priority fixes now. If you want, I can fill you in on what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I’d love the quick rundown. I usually join late, so just tell me what’s still needed and what time you’re thinking for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — we still need a few more volunteers, some basic tools, and a final list of priority fixes. I’m thinking we’ll aim for Saturday morning, but I can check the exact time and send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — a wrench and maybe a screwdriver would really help. Thanks, I’m trying not to forget this time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, I’ll keep it simple and jot down the wrench and screwdriver too. I’m still a bit worried about the pickup timing, but that should help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Pia — that helps a lot. If you’re writing it down, I’m less likely to miss it again.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sam, can you remind me which hardware store on Maple you’re using and what time you’ll be there?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m not Sam, but I can help if you need the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sorry, Leo — can you tell me which hardware store on Maple you mean and what time you’ll be there?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, please send them. I’ll take a look and see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can send them over right now. Let me know what else you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I’ll look it over and reach out if I can help with anything else.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: They still need a few more hands for sorting and pickup, plus tape, boxes, and maybe a ladder if anyone can lend one. I can ask around for the bigger items if you want.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can take sorting and pickup—what time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s great — thank you! I’ll check the time and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Cleo — I’m a bit all over the place, so a helping hand would be real nice. Just tell me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Start with the Miller place on Elm — their porch light’s been out for a week. I’ll gather the supplies we’ll need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the Miller place on Elm — I can head there now and get that porch light sorted. Thanks, Cleo, and holler if you need me to grab anything else.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a wrench and screwdriver I can bring by for the repair drive. Just say when and I’ll swing over.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Gus—let’s start with when you can swing by, and I’ll fit your wrench and screwdriver into the volunteer timing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara — I can swing by later this afternoon or early evening. Just tell me the time, and I’ll bring the wrench and screwdriver.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
